feats/illithid-grapple-1431.name: Illithid Grapple
feats/illithid-grapple-1431.effectSummary: Gain a tentacle natural attack dealing 1d4 damage. You can use it as a primary natural attack when unarmed, as either your weapon or tentacle for your primary attack when armed, or as a secondary natural attack during a full attack with a weapon. It does not increase reach. If you have Weapon Finesse, you may use Dexterity instead of Strength on tentacle attack rolls. A tentacle hit also grants improved grab usable only with that tentacle: you can start a grapple as a free action without provoking, but only against creatures within one size category of you.
feats/illithid-grapple-1431.specialSummary: You can take the feat up to four times, gaining another tentacle each time. After the fourth, your lower face resembles an illithid. As a full-round action you can give up all other attacks to attack with every tentacle and attempt a separate grapple from each hit, but you do not gain cumulative bonuses for multiple attached tentacles.

feats/improved-dragon-wings-1471.name: Improved Dragon Wings
feats/improved-dragon-wings-1471.effectSummary: Gain a 30-foot fly speed with average maneuverability. You cannot fly with a medium/heavy load or while fatigued/exhausted. Before 12 HD, safe continuous flight lasts a number of rounds equal to Constitution modifier, minimum 1; you can push to twice that duration but become fatigued, and spending more than 10 total minutes flying in a day also fatigues you. Gliding can extend time aloft. At 12 HD, flight requires no more exertion than walking/running; you can run in a straight line while flying and make a dive charge after flying at least 30 feet and descending at least 10 feet, dealing double damage with a piercing weapon on a hit.
